name: Seated Paced Breathing

instructions.description: Sit with feet supported and hands relaxed.
Follow a slow comfortable breathing rhythm.
Allow the abdomen and lower ribs to move naturally.
Continue without forcing depth or rate.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.

variations.variationDescription: Seated Paced Breathing — Shorter Practice Version: Use a shorter comfortable practice period while preserving relaxed breathing.

commentsNotes: Use a stable chair and a natural rhythm.
